Interface ShipControlController

All Superinterfaces:
GuiController
All Known Implementing Classes:
ShipControlControllerL1, ShipControlControllerL2
public interface ShipControlController extends GuiController
Interface for the Ship Control Controller in the GUI. This interface defines methods to update the view based on changes in the ship's state.

      void updateDestroyedComponent(String nickname, int x, int y) throws Exception
      Updates the view when a component of a player's ship board has been destroyed.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player whose ship board component was destroyed
      x - the x-coordinate of the destroyed component
      y - the y-coordinate of the destroyed component
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during the update

    • updateAlienChange

      void updateAlienChange(String nickname, int x, int y, boolean isPurple, boolean added) throws Exception
      Updates the view about a change in the number of aliens in a cabin.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player whose cabin's alien count has changed
      x - the x-coordinate of the cabin
      y - the y-coordinate of the cabin
      isPurple - true if the alien is purple, false otherwise
      added - true if an alien was added, false if one was removed
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during the update
